tools.name: get_health
tools.description: Health check for Girlfriend Gifts romantic gift inspiration. Returns ok, storage, paapi, trackingTag, defaultDomain, catalogCount (amazon.se), catalogCounts per storefront (amazon.se + amazon.com), marketplaceIds. Use list_marketplaces to discover storefronts. OpenAPI: getHealth.

tools.name: list_marketplaces
tools.description: List supported Amazon storefronts (id, domain, label, defaultLocale, currencyHint, tagConfigured). Agents MUST pick the user's marketplace and pass it on search/catalog/resolve.

tools.name: search_gifts
tools.description: Search Amazon for romantic partner gifts to build a recommendation or shopping list. Returns PA-API products when configured for the default storefront, otherwise romantic search deep-link cards + catalogMatches. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. OpenAPI: searchAmazon.

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: Curated girlfriend/wife gift catalogs for building shopping lists and wishlists: 245 amazon.se /dp ASINs (default) and a separate US catalog of ASINs verified live on amazon.com (pass marketplace=amazon.com → https://www.amazon.com/dp/ASIN buy links, tagged with the server-configured amazon.com tag

tools.name: resolve_product
tools.description: Resolve an ASIN, pasted Amazon /dp/ URL, or keywords to a buyUrl (product /dp or romantic search). ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale for the user. Does not invent Associates tags — uses server-configured tags per storefront. OpenAPI: resolveProduct.

tools.name: create_wishlist
tools.description: Create a girlfriend/wife gift list / wishlist for shopping-list building. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl (she edits), shopUrl (he/agent shops), wishlist, storage. Save editToken for add_wishlist_item. If storage is token, later mutations may return a new id — always use the latest. OpenAPI: createW

tools.name: create_and_fill
tools.description: Preferred agent path for list-building: create a gift wishlist and fill it with ASINs / keywords / search queries in one call. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, shopUrl. Pass marketplace + locale. OpenAPI: agentCreateAndFill.

tools.name: get_wishlist
tools.description: Fetch a wishlist by id. Returns wishlist items with buyUrl/linkType when available, plus ownerUrl and shopUrl. OpenAPI: getWishlist.

tools.name: add_wishlist_item
tools.description: Add an item to a gift list / wishlist (shopping-list building). Requires editToken from create. Body: name/title plus asin, url (pasted /dp), searchKeywords, or catalogId. Token storage may return a new id — update bookmarks. Prefer buyUrl in responses. OpenAPI: addWishlistItem.
